# Reanalyze

Reanalyze re-scores and re-aggregates an existing Run archive (`knowledge/concepts/Run archive.md`) with the current value function, estimand and normaliser, without calling the backend (`ExplainRunner.reanalyze(path)`, `nlp-shap reanalyze`). It re-aggregates with the archived estimator, so it reproduces `explain` for the same text-based value function, and it refuses a different estimator, absence policy or partition and archives of unfinished runs.

Fixed issue: C08 (`knowledge/issues/Fixed issues.md`); decision: Manifest schema version 2 (`knowledge/decisions/Pipeline decisions.md`).

Source: `knowledge/concepts/Reanalyze.md`.
